tripb.no_destinations: The destination list could not be loaded, so this screen cannot work yet.
tripb.interests: What do you like to do?
tripb.hours.aria: Rain for each hour of the day, one bar per hour
tripb.f.pwet: Usual chance of a wet day
tripb.f.p90: Rain on the wettest 1 day in 10
tripb.add.title: Add {place} to a trip
tripb.add.name: Name of the new trip
tripb.add.note: It is saved only in this browser. Open My trips to change the plan.
tripb.explore.title: Explore destinations
tripb.explore.lead: Pick a place on the map or in the list to see its weather for a day and what is good to do.
tripb.map.aria: Map of destinations. The list below has the same places.
tripb.d.no_forecast: The forecast could not be loaded and no saved copy is available. Please try again later.
tripb.d.no_day: The forecast has no data for this day.
tripb.d.no_tendency: There is no historical tendency for this area yet.
tripb.d.tendency_note: This day is further away than the forecast reaches. These numbers are what usually happens around this date over many years. They are not a forecast.
tripb.d.no_windows: No long dry stretch is expected this day.
tripb.act.title: What to do in this weather
tripb.act.lead: Rules based on the forecast for this day. Choose what you like to see those first.
tripb.act.none: No activity recommendation could be made.
tripb.act.need_forecast: Activity advice needs a forecast, which reaches only about 16 days ahead. Check again closer to the date.
tripb.act.no_hours: Opening hours are not known to this tool, so they are not shown. Check them before you go.
tripb.dash.title: Your trip dashboard
tripb.dash.welcome: Welcome. Check the weather for a place and a date, see which places look best, and watch for heavy rain, strong wind or heat.
tripb.dash.search_hint: Type a place name and choose it from the list.
tripb.dash.not_found: That place is not in the list. Choose one from the suggestions.
tripb.dash.bad_dates: Please choose valid dates. The end day cannot be before the start day.
tripb.dash.no_forecast: The forecast could not be loaded and no saved copy is available.
tripb.dash.sug_lead: Best places for {from} to {to}, using your saved choices.
tripb.dash.sug_more: Choose your own dates and interests
tripb.dash.no_suggestions: No suggestion could be made because the weather data could not be loaded.
tripb.dash.cmp_caption: The three best places for the same days
tripb.dash.copilot_text: Ask in plain words, for example which day is best for the beach. Answers come from the weather data shown here.
tripb.alert.heavy_rain.detail: From {when}. Strongest around {peak}: {value} mm in one hour.
tripb.alert.none: No heavy rain, strong wind or high heat is forecast in the next {days} days for {places}.
tripb.alert.failed: The forecast could not be loaded for {n} place(s), so they are not checked.
tripb.alert.limits: Alerts use your limits: rain from {rain} mm per hour, wind from {wind} km/h (gusts {gust}), heat from {heat} °C. Change them in Settings.
tripb.suggest.title: Smart destination suggestions
tripb.suggest.lead: Tell us when you can travel and what you like. We rank the places by weather, activities, your preferences and the ground conditions.
tripb.s.budget_hint: Cost levels are rough draft estimates.
tripb.s.max_rain: Most rain I accept (mm per day)
tripb.s.bad_start: Please choose a valid first day.
tripb.s.loading: Checking the weather for every place...
tripb.s.error: The suggestions could not be made. Please try again.
tripb.s.none: No place has weather data for these days, so nothing can be ranked.
tripb.s.skipped: {n} place(s) have no weather data for these days and are left out.
tripb.s.tendency_note: These days are beyond the {days}-day forecast. The ranking uses what usually happens around these dates (NASA POWER, many years). It is a tendency, not a forecast.
tripb.s.mixed_note: Some of these days are beyond the {days}-day forecast. Those days use the usual weather for the date (a tendency, not a forecast).
tripb.s.formula: Score S = {w} × W + {a} × A + {p} × P + {e} × E, each part from 0 to 100. The weights can be changed in Settings.
tripb.s.part.weather.what: Expected rain, chance of rain, heavy-rain hours, temperature and wind for your days.
tripb.s.part.activity.what: How well the weather suits the activities offered at the place and that you like.
tripb.s.part.preference.what: Match with your interests, budget, region and travel style.
tripb.s.part.environment.what: Slope and greenness of the land where data exists. Empty when not known.
tripb.s.period_tendency: Historical tendency for {from} to {to} (not a forecast)
tripb.s.period_mixed: Forecast for {fa} to {fb}; historical tendency for {ta} to {tb} (not a forecast)
tripb.s.stale: Part of this uses a saved forecast copy that is not current.
tripb.s.partial: Only {n} of {total} days have data. The score uses those days.
tripb.s.over_limit: More rain per day than your limit of {limit} mm.
tripb.s.acts_need_forecast: Activity advice needs a forecast. Things you can do here:
tripb.s.acts_none: No activity looks good in this weather.
tripb.set.title: Settings
tripb.set.lead: Change the limits used for the advice. They are saved only in this browser. The standard values are draft rules of thumb, not an official standard.
tripb.set.no_storage: This browser blocks saving. Changes work only until you close the page.
tripb.set.intensity.lead: The lowest rain in one hour for each name. Each must be higher than the one before.
tripb.set.comfort.lead: Used for the weather score and the alerts.
tripb.set.weights.lead: How much each part counts in the destination score (percent).
tripb.set.total_scaled: Total: {n}%. It is not 100%, so the weights are scaled to add up to 100% when saved.
tripb.set.weights.note: The score is a planning aid, not a scientific safety index.
tripb.set.cache.lead: A forecast loaded in this browser is reused for this long before it is fetched again.
tripb.set.language: The language is changed with the language button at the top of the page. The Sinhala text is a draft that still needs a native speaker to check it.
tripb.set.save_failed: Could not save. This browser blocks storage.
tripb.set.err.order_rain: Rain strengths must go up: light, moderate, heavy, very heavy.
tripb.set.err.order_temp: The comfortable temperature must start lower than it ends.
tripb.set.err.order_wind: Strong gusts must be above the windy limit.
tripb.set.err.weights_zero: At least one weight must be above zero.
tripb.model.title: Models and data in use
tripb.model.missing: The model information file is not available. No machine-learning estimate is used.
tripb.model.ml_yes: Shown, because a model beat the simple baseline on data it had not seen
tripb.model.ml_no: Not used: no model did better than the simple baseline on data it had not seen
tripb.model.caption: Models that were tested (lower Brier score is better)
tripb.model.rule: A machine-learning estimate is shown in the app only when it beats the baseline on held-out data. Hourly rain always comes from the Open-Meteo forecast, never from a model.
tripb.data.title: When the data was made
tripb.data.caption: Data files of the trip planner
tripb.data.fc_cache: The forecast of your last place was last fetched in this browser at {time}.
tripb.data.no_fc_cache: No forecast has been saved in this browser yet.
tripb.data.snapshot_at: The saved forecast copy was fetched at {time}. It is used only when the live forecast is not reachable and is then marked as not current.
tripb.data.errors: These files could not be loaded: {files}.
tripb.data.sources: Forecasts: Open-Meteo (not NASA). Historical tendencies: NASA POWER, 1981 to 2025. Places: OpenStreetMap and the project's own list. Seasonal outlooks are not NASA data either.
tripb.clear.title: Clear saved trips
tripb.clear.lead: Removes your saved trips and packing lists from this browser. Your settings and choices stay.
tripb.clear.btn: Clear saved trips and packing lists
tripb.clear.body: Delete {n} saved trip(s) and all packing lists from this browser? This cannot be undone.
tripb.clear.body_none: There are no saved trips. Delete any leftover packing lists from this browser? This cannot be undone.
tripb.clear.done: Saved trips and packing lists were deleted.
